query: How long does it take to process voluntary top-ups application to my MediSave Account?
reference_answer: The application relating to voluntary top-ups to MediSave Account will be processed as stated in the table below.ServiceProcessing TimeTop up MediSave AccountAlmost immediatelyIf the top-up amount is not reflected in your CPF accounts, please check your CPF account balance after five working days as more time may be needed to process the transaction. Such cases may arise due to intermittent network connectivity issues beyond CPF Board's control.Please alert us immediately if your payment is still not updated in your CPF account balance after five working days.
